# AWS Cost Explorer

Store account-wide cost definitions and query user-supplied USD actual-cost fixtures.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `costexplorer` |
| Signing name | `ce` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2017-10-25` |
| Scope | Account-wide |
| Execution | Fixture-backed queries; definitions remain records only |
| Selected operations | 19 of 47 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-cost-explorer) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No real AWS billing or price calculation, forecasts, recommendations, learned anomaly detection, anomaly queries, cost-category evaluation or notification delivery; USD fixture data only.
- Monitor LastEvaluatedDate, DimensionalValueCount, subscriber confirmation status and category processing status are omitted because no evaluation or confirmation is performed.
- Only the current cost category definition is retained; historical EffectiveOn reads preceding its EffectiveStart fail explicitly. SupportedResourceTypes filtering is not implemented.
- Cost allocation tag activation, billing views and other Cost Explorer operations are not implemented; unregistered operations use the gateway UnknownOperationException response.
- No CloudFormation resource handlers for AWS::CE::AnomalyMonitor, AWS::CE::AnomalySubscription or AWS::CE::CostCategory; CDK/awscc lifecycle support is not provided.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
